title: What the Decomposition Engine is
description: The engine takes an objective that looks impossible and returns a plan: a dependency graph of subtasks, each smaller than its parent, each with acceptance criteria, each assigned an owner and an estimate. Impossibility usually dissolves under decomposition — what remains is either a real blocker or a real plan.

title: Task and dependency data model
description: Every task is a record: its objective, acceptance criteria, estimated cost and duration, dependencies, owner, and status. title: Recursive decomposition algorithm
description: Decomposition recurses: a task too big to estimate is split by strategy (by phase, by component, by risk), and each child is split again until leaves are estimable and verifiable. The algorithm stops splitting when leaves meet the verifiability bar — not too fine (overhead) and not too coarse (unplannable).
